about.title: Oman's express delivery company
body: Asyad Express, a subsidiary of Asyad Group, provides express delivery, e-commerce solutions and warehousing. It works alongside Oman Post, sharing its leadership and its branch network.

It delivers door to door across all governorates of Oman, ships to more than 220 destinations and runs a fulfilment centre and warehouse at Muscat International Airport, with in-house customs clearance for international shipments.
more: Asyad Express says it is an Omani company through and through, with a nationwide network served by a professional Omani workforce.
Customers range from growing SMEs to international companies in e-commerce, manufacturing, services and finance.

services.title: Services
services.intro: Delivery in Oman and abroad, fulfilment, warehousing and services for online shoppers and brands.

items.title: Domestic Express
items.text: Door-to-door collection and delivery across Oman, in 24 to 72 hours.

detail.intro: Domestic Express provides door-to-door collection and deliveries across Oman for business and consumer customers within 24 to 72 hours.
body: Asyad Express covers every governorate, including remote areas. In December 2025 the company described same-day delivery within Muscat and up to 72 hours nationwide.
Shipments are tracked online from collection to delivery, with online proof of delivery and cash on delivery that also accepts card payments.
points: Online tracking from collection to delivery
Next business day or 24-hour delivery to most destinations
Cash on delivery, including card payments

items.title: International Express
items.text: Documents and parcels to more than 220 destinations, door to door.

detail.intro: International outbound premium express for documents and merchandise, delivered to the recipient's door in more than 220 destinations with insurance and tracking.
body: Delivery takes 24 to 48 hours within the GCC and 48 to 72 hours to other countries. The service is offered at Oman Post retail offices, the largest mailing network in Oman.

Price is based on actual or volumetric weight, whichever is higher; volumetric weight is length × width × height ÷ 5000. Customs fees in the destination country are paid by the receiver, or by the sender if they choose.
points: SMS to the receiver when the shipment arrives
SMS to the sender when it is delivered
Optional insurance at 2.5% of the shipment value
Bring sender and recipient ID, a valid phone number and the original invoice

items.title: Fulfilment Centre
items.text: Storage, pick, pack, label and dispatch for online sellers.

detail.intro: A dedicated warehouse space for receiving inventory, managing storage and completing orders, including picking, packing, labelling, dispatch and delivery with full tracking.
body: The fulfilment centre sits near Muscat International Airport and opened in March 2021. It handles online orders for domestic and international delivery and the returns that come back.
A fulfilment management system gives end-to-end visibility and reporting, from stock arriving to the parcel leaving the dock.
points: Total warehouse space of more than 3,500 m²
Receiving, secure storage, picking and packing, labelling and dispatch
Shipping to domestic and international destinations

items.title: Warehouse Solutions
items.text: Contract logistics space with airside access to Muscat International Airport.

detail.intro: Flexible space for contract logistics: storage of spare parts and finished goods for domestic or international distribution, monitored by a warehouse management system.
body: Stock is tracked from receipt and storage to order preparation, dispatch and delivery.
A bonded goods area with a customs office and x-ray machines speeds up inspection and clearance.
points: Airside access to Muscat International Airport
Bonded goods area, customs office and x-ray machines
Seven dock doors and three dock levellers
10 m free height and flexible racking

items.title: Ship Your Cart
items.text: Shop in the US and UK, ship to Oman through your own virtual address.

detail.intro: Ship Your Cart lets customers in Oman buy from online stores in the United States and the United Kingdom and ship the purchases home through shipyourcart.com.
body: Members get free virtual addresses in the US and UK. Parcels from different stores can be consolidated and shipped together.
Orders are processed within 24 hours and all fees are paid upfront, so nothing more is due when the shipment arrives.
points: Sign up free and get an overseas virtual address
Shop online and send purchases to that address
Declare the value, choose delivery and pay online
Collect from a branch or have it delivered to your door

items.title: Reverse Logistics
items.text: Doorstep pickup, quality checks and restocking of returns across the GCC.

detail.intro: An end-to-end returns service launched in July 2025 for retailers and digital-first brands.
body: With GCC-wide coverage, returns are picked up from the customer's door, checked and put back into inventory, with tracking for the whole cycle.
The service plugs into existing e-commerce and retail workflows for SMEs and large enterprises alike.

items.title: E-commerce Gateway
items.text: A route into GCC and MENA markets for international brands.

detail.intro: For international retailers, Asyad Express acts as a gateway to the GCC and MENA region: fulfilment in Oman, customs clearance in-house and delivery across the region.
body: Asyad Express describes a network with a strong presence in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar and Egypt, and an alliance with Oman Air for air freight.
Partners named in its announcements include Amazon, ASOS, Shein, iHerb, Evri, Landmark Group, Mumzworld, Temu and Caddie Couture.
points: Cash on delivery and returns management

catalogue.title: Delivery features
catalogue.intro: Payment, tracking, protection, packaging and digital tools that come with Asyad Express services.
catalogue.note: From Asyad Express service pages and announcements, read 12 Oct 2026. Rates are not published here; contact Asyad Express for a quote.

items.title: Cash on delivery
items.text: Your customer pays the courier, in cash or by card.
body: Cash on delivery is part of Domestic Express and accepts card payments as well as cash.
Temu added a cash-on-delivery option for shoppers in Oman through its partnership with Asyad Express in December 2024.

items.title: Online tracking
items.text: Follow a shipment from collection to delivery.
body: Domestic shipments are tracked online from collection to delivery; international shipments are tracked end to end.
Track and trace is available on the Asyad Express website, in the app and through the contact centres.

items.title: Proof of delivery
items.text: Online proof that the parcel arrived.
body: Domestic Express includes online proof of delivery (POD). International Express also provides proof of delivery.

items.title: SMS notifications
items.text: Texts to the receiver on arrival and to the sender on delivery.
body: For international shipments, the receiver gets an SMS when the shipment arrives, and the sender gets an SMS when the international recipient receives it.

items.title: Shipment insurance
items.text: Insure an international shipment for 2.5% of its value.
body: International shipments can be insured for 2.5% of the shipment value. In case of loss or damage, the shipment value is refunded in full.
Ship Your Cart purchases are also protected with shipment insurance.

items.title: Boxes, flyers and envelopes
items.text: A range of Asyad packaging for every size of shipment.
body: Domestic Express comes with an extensive range of boxes, flyers and envelopes.

items.title: Packing and wrapping
items.text: Full packaging and wrapping at the fulfilment centre.
body: The fulfilment centre provides a full packaging and wrapping solution for online orders before they are labelled and dispatched.

items.title: In-house customs clearance
items.text: Clearance handled in-house to cut transit times.
body: Asyad Express offers in-house customs clearance for international shipments, which it says reduces transit times and costs.
The warehouse has a bonded goods area, a customs office and x-ray machines.

items.title: Temperature-controlled storage
items.text: Ambient and temperature-controlled space for imports and exports.
body: The warehouse offers ambient and temperature-controlled environments, and the fulfilment centre was opened with cold and temperature-controlled storage for imports and exports.

items.title: Virtual US and UK addresses
items.text: Free overseas addresses for online shopping, through Ship Your Cart.
body: Ship Your Cart members get free virtual addresses in the United States and the United Kingdom, with consolidation of parcels from different stores.

items.title: Client portal
items.text: Business customers create orders, book pickups and print waybills online.
body: The Asyad Express client portal is where business customers manage their shipments. Asyad Express published a tutorial and an update video for it on its YouTube channel.
The dashboard menu includes an address book, express orders, fulfilment orders, reports, invoices, bulk waybills and support tickets.

items.title: Asyad Express app
items.text: Manage orders, schedule deliveries, calculate rates and find branches.
body: The Asyad Express app, published by Oman Post SAOC, lets customers manage orders, request new ones, schedule deliveries, calculate rates and locate branches and touchpoints.

partners.intro: Partners named in Asyad Express announcements

news.title: Asyad Express at DELIVER Europe 2026 in Amsterdam
news.summary: At booth A58, the team presented cross-border logistics that help European retailers reach GCC and MENA customers.
body: Asyad Express took part in DELIVER Europe 2026 at TAETS Event Park in Amsterdam on 3 and 4 June, an event bringing together more than 2,000 industry leaders and 140 logistics innovators.
At booth A58 the team showcased integrated logistics and cross-border e-commerce services designed to help European retailers access GCC and MENA markets.

news.title: Asyad Express strengthens last-mile delivery leadership
news.summary: Same-day delivery within Muscat and up to 72 hours nationwide, with cash on delivery, returns, insurance and packaging for growing businesses.
body: With an integrated delivery network covering all governorates of Oman, including remote areas, Asyad Express offers same-day delivery within Muscat and delivery of up to 72 hours nationwide.
Beyond core delivery, Asyad Express provides cash-on-delivery options, returns management, shipment insurance and packaging solutions that help SMEs streamline operations and reach more customers.
The company says it is intensifying its focus on digital transformation to improve efficiency, widen coverage and deliver a fully integrated logistics experience, in line with Oman Vision 2040.

news.title: Asyad Express forms alliance with Temu, Landmark Group and Amazon
news.summary: Partners include Amazon, ASOS, Shein, iHerb, Evri, Landmark Group, Mumzworld and Temu, with delivery across Oman, the GCC, the Middle East and North Africa.
body: Asyad Express, part of Asyad Group, works with global e-commerce and retail brands including Amazon, ASOS, Shein, iHerb, Evri, Landmark Group, Mumzworld and Temu, as well as luxury and lifestyle players.

Its delivery solutions span Oman, the GCC, the Middle East and North Africa, supported by direct connectivity with Oman's ports, airports and free zones and by digital systems for real-time shipment tracking.

news.title: Asyad Express partners with Caddie Couture
news.summary: Asyad Express will manage end-to-end fulfilment and delivery across the GCC for the UK golf fashion brand.
body: Asyad Express has signed a strategic agreement with Caddie Couture, a UK-based premium golf fashion brand.
Under the partnership, Asyad Express manages end-to-end fulfilment and delivery across the GCC, from warehousing and inventory management to last-mile delivery.
Jason Ashbrook, VP Commercial at Asyad Express, said the agreement combines Caddie Couture's designs with Asyad Express's logistics network to serve GCC customers.

news.title: Asyad Express launches a reverse logistics platform
news.summary: Doorstep pickup, quality checks and restocking of returned goods across the GCC, tracked from start to finish.
body: Asyad Express has launched an end-to-end reverse logistics service for retailers and digital-first brands.
With GCC-wide coverage, the service includes doorstep pickup, quality checks and the reintegration of returned goods into inventory, with visibility and tracking throughout.

It is built to plug into existing e-commerce and retail workflows for businesses of all sizes, from SMEs to large enterprises, so they can offer more flexible return policies and shorter turnaround times.

news.title: Asyad Express expands its partnership with Amazon
news.summary: Next-day delivery to every corner of Oman for Amazon customers, after an 81% rise in Amazon volume in Oman in 2024.
body: Combining Amazon's global reach with Asyad Express's local network gives customers tracking and next-day delivery services to every corner of Oman.
Amazon operations in Oman grew 81% in volume in 2024, according to the announcement.
Asyad Express ships to more than 220 destinations and territories, completes deliveries in 24 to 72 hours and provides in-house customs clearance for international shipments.

news.title: A key player in GCC e-commerce and luxury lifestyle products
news.summary: More than 925,000 shipments from January to November 2024 in luxury and lifestyle e-commerce, up from over 600,000 in 2023.
body: Asyad Express reports significant growth in luxury and lifestyle e-commerce. In 2023 it handled over 600,000 shipments; from January to November 2024 it processed more than 925,000.
Its services include storage facilities covering over 5,700 square metres, delivery connecting local and regional markets and a distribution network reaching more than 220 destinations.
Asyad Express names Shein, ASOS, Amouage, Boutiqaat, Rydan and Lattafa among its partners, and offers cash on delivery, returns management, customs clearance, packaging and shipment tracking.

news.title: Temu and Asyad Express partner on fulfilment in Oman
news.summary: Temu named Asyad Express its local fulfilment partner in Oman and added cash on delivery for shoppers.
body: Temu announced a strategic partnership with Asyad Express to improve delivery across Oman and the fulfilment process for its customers.
As part of the alliance, Temu added a cash-on-delivery payment option.
Jason Ashbrook, Vice President of Commercial at Asyad Express, said the companies aim to ensure customer satisfaction in delivery and fulfilment.

news.title: Asyad Express signs pacts with e-commerce firms
news.summary: Partners include Amazon, ASOS, Shein, iHerb, Evri, Landmark Group and Mumzworld.
body: Asyad Express partners with brands such as Amazon, ASOS, Shein, iHerb, Evri, Landmark Group and Mumzworld to speed up online purchasing and delivery across the region.

In 2023 and early 2024, Asyad Express supported ASOS, Shein and Landmark Retail with over $12 million in logistics support and delivery services covering Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar and the UAE.

news.title: A gateway to the GCC and MENA for international partners
news.summary: Presence in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar and Egypt, in-house customs clearance and an air freight alliance with Oman Air.
body: Asyad Express describes its network as spanning the GCC and MENA region, with a strong presence in Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar and Egypt, delivering to over 220 destinations.
Its in-house customs clearance and its alliance with Oman Air for air freight make it a one-stop shop for logistics and express delivery.
Services for international partners include express delivery, land and air freight and customs clearance, supported by e-fulfilment centres with parcel security, labelling and temperature control.

news.title: Oman Post and Asyad Express at Seamless Middle East 2024
news.summary: The team showed fulfilment, warehousing and in-house customs clearance to visitors in Dubai.
body: Oman Post and Asyad Express presented their postal and logistics services at the Seamless Middle East 2024 exhibition in Dubai.
Visitors to the booth explored postal and e-commerce express solutions, including e-fulfilment centres, AI-based systems for warehousing and in-house customs clearance.

news.title: Land investment agreements in Bausher and Amerat
news.summary: Wujha Real Estate and Bayan Investment House will develop two Asyad sites under 25-year agreements.
body: Asyad Group, represented by Oman Post and Asyad Express, signed investment partnerships with Wujha Real Estate Development Company and Bayan Investment House.
Under Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Transfer arrangements, the two companies will invest in two Asyad sites in Bausher and Amerat. The partnership runs for 25 years.

news.title: Asyad Express partners with Evri on an e-commerce gateway hub
news.summary: Oman becomes Evri's exclusive e-commerce fulfilment hub in the Middle East, and Omani SMEs gain a route to sell worldwide.
body: Asyad Express signed an agreement with Evri, the UK's largest dedicated parcel delivery company, during Bloomberg's event 'Foreign Direct Investment: Scaling New Heights'.

Jason Ashbrook, VP Commercial at Asyad Express, said the partnership places Oman as Evri's exclusive e-commerce fulfilment hub in the Middle East, and that the two companies will develop an international outbound product giving Omani SMEs a platform to sell worldwide.
Shaikh Ibrahim bin Sultan Al Hosni, then Acting CEO of Oman Post and Asyad Express, said the alliance will also provide international customer service support in local languages.

news.title: Ship Your Cart brings US and UK shopping to Oman
news.summary: Free virtual addresses in the US and UK, consolidation, tracking and delivery to the door or the nearest post office.
body: Asyad Express introduced Ship Your Cart, an e-commerce service for shipping purchases from online stores in the United States and the United Kingdom to Oman through shipyourcart.com.

Jason Ashbrook, then Vice President Commercial, said the service includes free virtual addresses in the US and UK, order consolidation, shipment tracking and doorstep delivery or collection from the nearest post office.
Orders are processed within 24 hours and all fees are paid in advance, so there are no extra charges when the shipment arrives.

news.title: Asyad Express partners with Tanzania Posts
news.summary: A memorandum to promote last-mile services and e-commerce between Oman and Tanzania, including e-locker know-how.
body: Asyad Group, represented by Oman Post and Asyad Express, signed a memorandum of understanding with Tanzania Posts Corporation to promote last-mile services and e-commerce solutions between the two countries.
The MoU covers knowledge transfer, including the introduction of e-locker solutions in Tanzania, and a joint postal stamp celebrating the two countries' shared history.

news.title: Khedmah offers Oman Post and Asyad Express services at 44 branches
news.summary: PO box subscriptions and local and international parcels at Khedmah locations across Oman.
body: Oman Investment & Finance Company (Khedmah) now provides Oman Post and Asyad Express services at 44 Khedmah branches across the Sultanate.
Services include PO box subscriptions, renewals and fee payments, and mailing parcels locally and internationally.

Locations include Muscat City Center, Muscat Grand Mall, Nesto Hypermarket Al Maabilah, Liwan Al Safina Complex in Al Ghubra, Al Nawras Mall in Al Khuwair, Safeer Mall Sohar, Al Jabal Al Akhdar and Al Ashkharah.

news.title: Private-sector outlets reach 107, with 213 planned
news.summary: New service outlets opened with private partners lifted postal revenue in Muscat Governorate by 43%.
body: Oman Post and Asyad Express, with the Authority for Small and Medium Enterprises Development, opened registration for SMEs to provide postal services.
CEO Nasser al Sharji said the number of new outlets set up through private-sector partners had reached 107, and that they had helped postal revenue rise by 43% in Muscat Governorate.
Another 48 outlets were planned by the end of 2022, for a total of 213.

news.title: Vodafone Oman picks Asyad Express for fulfilment and delivery
news.summary: End-to-end fulfilment and express delivery, run from the fulfilment centre on Sultan Qaboos Highway near Muscat International Airport.
body: Asyad Express signed an agreement with Vodafone Oman for end-to-end fulfilment and express delivery services.

The service runs from the fulfilment centre on Sultan Qaboos Highway in Muscat, part of the 3,000 m² Asyad Express hub near Muscat International Airport, which handles storage, pick, pack and dispatch of online orders and returns.

news.title: Al Wahaibi returns to international rallying with Asyad Express
news.summary: Omani driver Hamed Al Wahaibi began his programme at the Jordan Rally with Asyad Express support.
body: Omani rally driver Hamed Al Wahaibi returned to international rallying with the support of Asyad Express, starting at the Jordan Rally, round two of the FIA Middle East Rally Championship.

The release noted that Asyad Express then ran its business through six centres around the Sultanate, providing express pick-up and delivery across sectors including e-commerce, manufacturing, services and finance.

news.title: Fulfilment centre opens near Muscat International Airport
news.summary: Storage, pick, pack and dispatch, returns handling, and cold and temperature-controlled storage under one roof.
body: Oman Post ASYAD Express opened its fulfilment centre close to Muscat International Airport, offering storage, pick, pack and dispatch of online orders for domestic and international delivery, and the handling of returns.

The centre offers next-day delivery to many addresses in select locations across Oman and up to three days to remote areas; deliveries to the GCC, the wider Middle East and the rest of the world take one to four days.
It provides packaging and wrapping, cold and temperature-controlled storage, a logistics management system with end-to-end visibility, and 24-hour on-site security with CCTV.

news.title: Asyad Express International launches to 220+ destinations
news.summary: Door-to-door shipping of parcels up to 25 kg, in 48 to 72 hours, and as little as 24 hours to major GCC cities.
body: Oman Post ASYAD Express launched ASYAD Express International, a door-to-door shipping service to over 220 destinations, available at all 86 Oman Post branches and with pickup for corporate customers.
Customers can ship packages of up to 25 kg, delivered in 48 to 72 hours, and to major GCC cities in as little as 24 hours, with track and trace on the website and through the contact centres.

faq.q: How long will the shipment take to be delivered?
faq.a: Asyad Express's FAQ says two days within Muscat Governorate and three days to other regions, with deliveries to Musandam once a week. In December 2025 the company described same-day delivery within Muscat and up to 72 hours nationwide.

faq.q: Can I reschedule the delivery time?
faq.a: Yes. Call the Asyad Express call centre on 1001 to reschedule your delivery.
Asyad Express provides pick-up and delivery for businesses of all types in Oman, from growing SMEs to international companies in e-commerce, manufacturing, services and finance.
A dedicated warehouse space for receiving inventory, managing storage and completing orders for businesses, including picking, packing, labelling, dispatch and delivery with full tracking.

faq.q: How much can I send abroad?
faq.a: International Express takes documents and merchandise up to 30 kg to more than 220 destinations. Price is based on actual or volumetric weight (L × W × H ÷ 5000), whichever is higher.

faq.q: Can I insure an international shipment?
faq.a: Yes. Insurance costs 2.5% of the shipment value, and the full value is refunded in case of loss or damage.

faq.q: How do I reach the sales team?
faq.a: Fill in the contact form with your details and the sales team will reply within two working days.

faq.q: What if my shipment is damaged, wrong or missing?
faq.a: Send the details through the contact form and customer service will reply within two working days.

confirm: The official sites (asyadexpress.om, asyadexpress.com, asyad.com) rejected automated access from our network. Service pages, FAQ, office locator and some news were read from asyad.baryons.net, a public copy of the Asyad Express site that still contains placeholder text; confirm everything against the live site.
International weight limit: the service page says 30 kg; the January 2021 launch release says 25 kg. The concept shows 30 kg.

Domestic delivery times: the FAQ says 2 days in Muscat and 3 days elsewhere (Musandam weekly); the December 2025 article says same day in Muscat and up to 72 hours nationwide. Both are shown, attributed.
Outside-Oman phone: the contact page copy shows +968 2492 2000; a third-party tracker lists +968 2115 3500. Asyad's address directory lists +968 2450 6999. Confirm the current number.
Branch opening hours are not published on the locator; branch pages say 'call 1001 to confirm'. Branch photos are generic Asyad Express photos, not the branch itself.
Branch count (79) and touchpoints (103) are counts of the office-locator data on 12 Oct 2026. The 2021 release mentions 86 Oman Post branches; the 2021 rally release mentions six centres.
'10% off your first shipment' (Ship Your Cart) appears on the site copy without dates; confirm it is still running before using the offer slide-in.

Photos come from Asyad Express's own channels as republished by Times of Oman, Oman Observer, Muscat Daily, LinkedIn and YouTube (thumbnails and video stills). Get original files and permission from Asyad Express before launch. The Evri hub photo belongs to Evri; the airport render belongs to Oman Aviation Group.
Leadership named in the news (Nasser Al Sharji, Shaikh Ibrahim Al Hosni, Jason Ashbrook) is as of each article's date; check current titles.
No company film could be downloaded from an official site, so the slider has no video slide.
Logo extracted from the Asyad Express app icon (App Store) and made transparent; replace with the vector logo.
The 'track a parcel' entry points to the contact form preview; the real tracking box must connect to Asyad Express systems.
Government-owned group: a redesign would go through a tender. This is a concept only.
